subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Design can be quiet, but it has power.”?
options: Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.
It can invite, guide, limit, or exclude.
Rules can limit harm and make better conversation possible.
Sometimes opening a door is enough to invite people in.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Design can be quiet, but it has power. It can invite, guide, limit, or exclude.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Rules can limit harm and make better conversation possible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes opening a door is enough to invite people in.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Design can be quiet, but it has power. It can invite, guide, limit, or exclude.」，答案為「It can invite, guide, limit, or exclude.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It can invite, guide, limit, or exclude.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
